summary: AMETEK filed an 8-K announcing the completion of its acquisition of First Aviation Services, a defense and aviation MRO and components manufacturer. No financial terms (price per share, equity value, or premium) were disclosed in the filing. The press release states the target generates approximately $80 million in annual revenue and will integrate into AMETEK's Electromechanical Group. No board recommendation or advisor names are provided. The acquisition is closed as of May 26, 2026, with no regulatory or financing conditions mentioned. What to watch: integration updates and revenue contribution details in subsequent filings.
